UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Registered and authorized user account details

approved.description: Whether user is approved to access the applet

displayName.description: User display name from Google auth

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in ISO format

SpellerProfile.title: SpellerProfile
SpellerProfile.description: Child speller profile associated with a parent user account

userId.description: UID of the owning parent account

name.description: Child's speller nickname or first name

roundsCompleted.description: Total number of spelling rounds completed

struggledWords.description: List of words the child struggled with (repeated until mastered)

masteredWords.description: List of words the child spelled correctly (never asked again)

consecutiveHighScores.description: Consecutive rounds scored >= 9 at current level

ownerId.description: UID of the creator parent account

ownerEmail.description: Email address of the creator parent

sharedWithEmails.description: List of collaborator Gmail accounts with shared access

collaboratorEmails.description: All authorized account emails (owner + shared accounts) for index queries

updatedByEmail.description: Email address of the user who last edited this profile

WordHistoryRecord.title: WordHistoryRecord
WordHistoryRecord.description: Individual word result record for auditing, analytics, and CSV export

status.description: Whether the word was spelled correctly or incorrectly

childAttempt.description: What the child actually wrote or transcribed

wasRevealed.description: Whether the child revealed the word spelling during the round

phonemes.description: Phonemic patterns associated with the word

ApprovedUser.title: ApprovedUser
ApprovedUser.description: Approved whitelist entry permitting Google user email to access the app

role.description: Role granted to the approved email

addedBy.description: Email or UID of admin who approved this user

WordBankLevel.title: WordBankLevel
WordBankLevel.description: Pre-populated spelling word bank for a specific difficulty level (1-5)

words.description: Array of curated WordItem objects for this level

TtsAudioCache.title: TtsAudioCache
TtsAudioCache.description: Pre-created compressed MP3 TTS audio clip for a spelling word

/users/{userId}.description: Parent user document storing account state and access privileges

/users/{userId}/profiles/{profileId}.description: Child speller profile associated with a specific account

/users/{userId}/word_history/{historyId}.description: Word attempt log for reporting, progress tracking, and CSV exports

/approved_users/{emailId}.description: Allowlist entries of approved email accounts managed by administrators

/word_bank/{levelId}.description: Pre-populated word bank sharded by difficulty level (level_1 to level_5)

/tts_cache/{wordKey}.description: Pre-created TTS audio cache for spelling words to eliminate AI TTS token usage

/shared_profiles/{profileId}.description: Shared child speller profile synced across family and educator accounts

/shared_profiles/{profileId}/history/{hi.description: Historical word attempt logs for shared child speller profile
